answer: Resist sybils with a scarce-sponsor voucher. An established miner may underwrite at most two new keys per epoch, locking a refundable deposit slashed if that seed-bound answer later matches another under a published similarity test. Rewards stay locked until a random non-sponsor committee grades the text and a majority mark it original. Audit this by counting a sponsor's epoch vouchers, re-running the similarity filter, and reading the published grades. At a river checkpoint, a nebula of skiffs still waits; the lock will only forge a pass after a named captain stakes their own berth.
